'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 David McCune LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' nothing better came to mind
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
